text:
Zoe Patel: Orion Analytics sent invoice ORN-7702 for $16,200 but there's no PO on the PDF and line 3 (model tuning hours) looks overstated compared to our usage report.
Marcus Chen: Do we have a PO for them?
Zoe Patel: We have PO-9650 for analytics tooling, but vendor invoice doesn't reference it.
Lina Gomez: Coupa auto-match failed; APBot flagged NO_PO_MATCH and CHARGE_DISPUTE on line items.
APBot: Invoice ORN-7702 flagged: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket AP-55988 created. Required approvers: Lina Gomez (Product Ops), Josef R (FP&A).
Ravi Shah: Vendor claims the extra tuning hours were premium and non-contractual. Can we get usage logs to dispute amount before paying?
Marcus Chen: I asked EngInfra for the job run logs; posted a link. Looks like 40 hours billed vs. 12 hours in our logs for the same period.
Lina Gomez: Vendor offered to reduce invoice by 50% if we can't reach a resolution in 3 days. They also offered to reissue with PO-9650 if we accept the adjusted amount.
Josef R: FP&A position: don't pay until dispute is resolved unless service impact. We can approve partial holdback for disputed amount and pay undisputed remainder. Need Product Ops approval for holdback and AP to record memo.
Zoe Patel: I'll request a corrected invoice with PO-9650 and a clear line-by-line credit for disputed tuning hours. Also asked vendor to provide job IDs for billed runs.
APBot: AP ticket updated: holdback proposed 30% of invoice pending dispute resolution. Please record approvals.
Lina Gomez: Approve holdback and payment of undisputed portion. Josef, please confirm cash and GL mapping.
Josef R: Confirm GL 6108 and approve payment of undisputed $11,340. Holdback $4,860 pending vendor evidence. PAYMENT_HOLD partially cleared; payment scheduled 2026-07-10 for undisputed amount.
Zoe Patel: Notifying Orion and requesting reissued invoice referencing PO-9650 and line-item credits. Will attach vendor response to AP-55988 when received.
Marcus Chen: Keep ticket open until vendor provides logs or issues credit note. Good catch on the run IDs.
